generic_abi.memory: one defined unshared memory0; all pointer/length/handle parameters remain i64

families.semantics: One bounded planar goal computed from returned state, native terminal success and fresh resulting pose; no motor/gait/torque/3D semantics
families.native_confirmation: Native NavigateToPose SUCCEEDED, all release-specific native error/result fields indicating success, correlated UUID and fresh pose within SI-converted tolerances. Goal acceptance alone is insufficient.

families.semantics: One actual mono8/RGB8 frame enters Wasm; Wasm validates dimensions/stride and computes FNV-1a-32 over payload including padding
families.output: epoch/sequence/frame-key/encoding/dimensions/stride/byte-count/computed FNV JSON; no raw image capture by default
families.native_confirmation: Official simulator->native ROS Image->authorized VM memory copy->executing Wasm computation. Independently compare exact native sample payload SHA256 to audited input-copy SHA256 and recompute FNV; FNV alone is not a cryptographic provenance proof.

common_requirements: software simulation only; no physical robot effects
strict bounded UTF8 JSON: reject duplicate/unknown keys, NUL, nonfinite numbers and overflow
adapter identity is SHA256 of exact complete bytes including whitespace; policy and Wasm SHA are separate
host binds exact Wasm/policy/adapter, actor owner, capability, resource graph, simulator instance and epoch on every call
host checks monotonic freshness and native sample/result provenance before returning data
external adapters own resource names, native units, coordinate transforms, calibration and release/ABI mappings
nonzero unsupported capability or unit conversions are refused; never emulate navigation/image data through joint commands
replay is not automatic; stale/closed/foreign handles and mismatched epochs must fail without native effects
acceptance: each algorithm frozen once per version; exact SHA reused before/after each applicable platform run
VM/native ROS/official simulator/QEMU/performance and architecture/distro/library/language rows remain independent
source_preview_0_2_0: Preserved unchanged as history; its planar16/17/18 milliradian frames are not accepted as version0.3.0 navigation frames
algorithm_availability: See separate immutable artifact receipts after actual Linux compilation
